sections.Primal Companion: This optional Beast Master feature is available at ranger level 3 and replaces Ranger’s Companion. The beast is friendly and uses the Land, Sea, or Sky stat block. Choose an animal appropriate for that profile. Whatever its shape, it has primal markings. It acts during the ranger’s turn and may move or react on its own. Unless the ranger commands it using a bonus action, its default action is Dodge. The ranger may instead give up one attack when taking the Attack action to command the beast to Attack. If the ranger is incapacitated, the beast can choose its action freely. Within an hour after the beast dies, the ranger may touch it as an action and spend a spell slot of level 1 or higher. After one minute it returns to life at full HP. After a long rest the ranger may instead summon another beast into an unoccupied space within 5 feet, choosing the profile and animal shape anew. An existing companion vanishes when the replacement appears. The beast also vanishes if the ranger dies.
sections.Scaling: Natural armor gives AC 13 + the ranger’s proficiency bonus. The beast uses that proficiency bonus, understands the languages its ranger speaks, and has darkvision 60 ft. and passive Perception 12. The printed challenge line has no rating. Medium Beast. HP equals 5 + 5 × ranger level, with one d8 Hit Die per ranger level. Walk and climb 40 ft. each. STR 14, DEX 14, CON 15, INT 8, WIS 14, CHA 11.
sections.Traits: Primal Bond lets the ranger add their proficiency bonus to the beast’s ability checks and saving throws. Charge adds 1d6 slashing damage if the beast moves at least 20 ft. straight toward a target and hits it with Maul that turn. A creature hit this way makes a Strength save against the ranger’s spell save DC or falls prone.
sections.Action: Maul is a melee weapon attack against one target within 5 ft. Use the ranger’s spell attack modifier to hit. On a hit, deal 1d8 + 2 + PB slashing damage.

sections.Summon Beast: Summon Beast is a 2nd-level conjuration. It takes an action, has range 90 ft., and requires concentration for up to an hour. It uses verbal and somatic components plus a gilded acorn worth at least 200 gp containing a feather, a tuft of fur, and a fish tail. Choose Air, Land, or Water when casting, and choose a native animal shape for that environment. One corporeal spirit appears in an unoccupied space the caster can see within range, is friendly to the caster and their companions, and vanishes when reduced to 0 HP or when the spell ends. The spirit takes its turn immediately after the caster on the same initiative count. Verbal commands cost the caster no action. With no command, it Dodges and moves away from danger.
sections.Scaling: Small Beast. AC equals 11 + spell slot level using natural armor. The spirit uses the caster’s proficiency bonus, has darkvision 60 ft. and passive Perception 12, and understands the languages the caster speaks. STR 18, DEX 11, CON 16, INT 4, WIS 14, CHA 5. The printed block provides no challenge rating or Hit Dice. The three modes share a 30-ft. walking speed. See the forms for additional speeds and starting HP. A higher slot counts as the spell level throughout the profile.
sections.Air: At 2nd level it has 20 HP, increasing by 5 for every slot level above 2nd. It walks 30 ft. and flies 60 ft. Flyby lets it leave an enemy’s reach while flying without provoking opportunity attacks.
sections.Land: At 2nd level it has 30 HP, increasing by 5 for every slot level above 2nd. It walks and climbs 30 ft. Pack Tactics gives advantage on an attack roll against a creature if a non-incapacitated ally of the spirit is within 5 ft. of that creature.
sections.Water: At 2nd level it has 30 HP, increasing by 5 for every slot level above 2nd. It walks and swims 30 ft. Water Breathing limits it to breathing underwater. Pack Tactics gives advantage on an attack roll against a creature if a non-incapacitated ally of the spirit is within 5 ft. of that creature.
sections.Actions: Multiattack makes a number of attacks equal to half the slot level, rounded down. Maul is a melee weapon attack against one target within 5 ft. Use the caster’s spell attack modifier to hit. On a hit, deal 1d8 + 4 + the slot level piercing damage.
sections.Appearance: The caster chooses the shape of one native animal when casting. The wolf portrait gives one example. The Air, Land, and Water profiles are choices within the same printed block.

sections.Primal Companion: At Ranger level 3, choose a Land, Sea, or Sky form and an animal suited to it. The beast has visible primal markings, is Friendly to you and your allies, and obeys you. It vanishes if you die. It acts on your turn, and it can move and use its reaction independently. It normally takes Dodge. Spend a bonus action to have it take another action, or replace one attack of your Attack action to have it use Beast’s Strike. If you are Incapacitated, the beast chooses its own actions. If it died within the past hour, take a Magic action to touch it and spend a spell slot. It revives after 1 minute with full HP. Finishing a long rest lets you choose a new form and appearance, summoning it into an unoccupied space within 5 ft. and replacing the prior beast.
sections.Scaling: AC is 13 + the ranger’s Wisdom modifier. The beast uses the ranger’s proficiency bonus. It has no CR and grants 0 XP. It understands the ranger’s languages. Passive Perception 12. HP is 5 + five times the ranger level. The beast has one d8 Hit Die per ranger level.
sections.Statistics: Medium neutral Beast. Walk and climb 40 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Str 14, Dex 14, Con 15, Int 8, Wis 14, Cha 11. Base save modifiers in that order are +2, +2, +2, −1, +2 and +0.
sections.Traits: Primal Bond. Add the ranger’s proficiency bonus to all of the beast’s ability checks and saving throws.
sections.Actions: Beast’s Strike. Melee attack using the ranger’s spell attack modifier with a 5-ft. reach. A hit deals 1d8 + 2 + the ranger’s Wisdom modifier. Choose Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing on summoning. If the beast moved 20 ft. or more in a straight line toward the target before hitting, add 1d6 of that type. A Large or smaller creature hit under that movement condition also falls Prone.
sections.Higher-level Beast Master features: At Ranger level 7, whenever a bonus action commands the beast to act, you may also have it use its own bonus action for Dash, Disengage, Dodge, or Help. Its attack damage can be Force or its normal type. At level 11, a command to use Beast’s Strike lets it strike twice. The first time each turn it hits a creature affected by your Hunter’s Mark, it deals extra Force damage equal to the mark’s bonus damage. At level 15, when you cast a spell targeting yourself, it can also affect your beast if it is within 30 ft.
sections.Appearance: The ranger chooses an animal suited to this form. It bears visible primal markings. The portrait shows a wolf.

sections.Initiative and commands: The spirit allies with you and your allies. It takes its turn immediately after yours at the same initiative count and obeys your verbal commands without an action cost. If you give no orders, it takes Dodge and uses its movement to avoid danger.
sections.Statistics: Small neutral Beast. Str 18, Dex 11, Con 16, Int 4, Wis 14, Cha 5. Base save modifiers in that order are +4, +0, +3, −3, +2 and −3. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 12. Understands the caster’s languages. No CR, 0 XP, and proficiency bonus equals the caster’s.
sections.Actions: Multiattack. Make a number of Rend attacks equal to half the slot level, rounded down. Rend. Make a melee attack roll using the caster’s spell attack modifier with a 5-ft. reach. A hit deals 1d8 + 4 + the slot level in Piercing damage.
sections.Scaling: AC is 11 + the spell slot level. Start with 30 HP and add 5 HP per slot level above 2.
sections.Traits:
Pack Tactics. The spirit rolls attacks against a creature with advantage if at least one spirit ally within 5 ft. of that creature is free of the Incapacitated condition.
Water Breathing. The spirit breathes only underwater.
sections.Appearance: The caster chooses a native water animal. The portrait shows a crocodile.

sections.Summoning: Giant Insect is a level 4 Druid conjuration. It takes an action to cast, requires verbal and somatic components, and lasts up to 10 minutes with concentration. Choose a giant centipede, spider, or wasp at casting. It appears in an unoccupied space the caster can see within 60 ft. and vanishes at 0 HP or when the spell ends.
sections.Initiative and commands: The summoned creature is allied with the caster and the caster’s allies. It acts on the caster’s initiative count, immediately after the caster. Verbal commands cost the caster no action. Without orders, the insect takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger.
sections.Scaling: Use the slot level for the spell level in these formulas. AC equals 11 + spell level. HP equals 30 + 10 per spell level above 4. Its Proficiency Bonus equals the caster’s. The block gives no CR and 0 XP.
sections.Statistics: Large Beast, Unaligned. STR 17 (+3), DEX 13 (+1), CON 15 (+2), INT 4 (−3), WIS 14 (+2), CHA 3 (−4). The saving throw modifiers match these six modifiers. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 12. The insect understands its caster’s languages.
sections.Movement: Walk 40 ft. and climb 40 ft. The wasp form also flies 40 ft.
sections.Traits: Spider Climb. The insect climbs difficult surfaces and ceilings without an ability check.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make half the spell level in attacks, rounded down.
Poison Jab. Melee attack roll using the caster’s spell attack modifier, with 10-ft. reach. A hit deals 1d6 + 3 + spell level piercing damage and 1d4 poison damage.
Web Bolt (Spider only). Ranged attack roll using the caster’s spell attack modifier, with 60-ft. range. A hit deals 1d10 + 3 + spell level bludgeoning damage and reduces the target’s Speed to 0 until the start of the insect’s next turn.
sections.Bonus actions: Venomous Spew (Centipede only). One creature the centipede can see within 10 ft. makes a Constitution saving throw against the caster’s spell save DC. On a failure it is Poisoned until the start of the insect’s next turn.
sections.Printing note: The first printing applied the extra 10 HP per spell level. The official correction applies the increase only for levels above 4. This summary uses the corrected formula.
